integrity: The theorem is supported by an analytical proof and supplemented by an executable checker. No claim of independent audit, certification or comprehensive historical-priority verification is made.
limitations: Only intersections of congruent unit Euclidean cylinders about the n mutually orthogonal coordinate axes in n-dimensional Euclidean space, for integers n at least two; no extension to tilted or unequal-radius cylinders. Exact n=3,4,5 volumes are previously known. Full texts of the 2012 and 2013 Illinois Geometry Lab reports were inaccessible for close comparison, leaving a substantive historical-priority risk.
title: Strict volume monotonicity and a sharp two-term defect for orthogonal hypercylinders
